title: Wing Anti-Ice Shut-Off Valve — Installation of the Solenoid and Position Sensing Assembly

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the solenoid and the position sensing assembly on a wing anti-ice shut-off valve, with the harness support repositioning required at the high force standard and the travel and timing acceptance check.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install the solenoid and the position sensing assembly on a wing anti-ice shut-off valve, to reposition the harness support where the high force solenoid is fitted, and to do the travel and timing acceptance check.
sections.job_setup_note: The high force solenoid is longer than the original and the harness support must be moved 40 mm inboard so that the solenoid clears the piccolo duct flange. The sealing washers are single use. The travel and timing check must be done at a duct temperature below 40 degrees, because a warm valve gives a time that is not representative. Two persons are needed, one at the valve and one at the flight deck.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the pneumatic system is depressurised and that the warning notice is in position. 2. Remove the blanking plugs from the valve body. 3. Clean the mating faces and examine them for damage. 4. Install the position sensing assembly with new sealing washers. 5. Install the solenoid square to the valve body and tighten the retaining nuts progressively to 12 Nm. CAUTION: DO NOT TIGHTEN ONE NUT FULLY BEFORE THE OTHER. AN UNEVEN LOAD DISTORTS THE SOLENOID FLANGE AND CHANGES THE ARMATURE CLEARANCE. 6. Lockwire the retaining nuts. 7. Where the high force solenoid is fitted, move the harness support clamp 40 mm inboard to the position shown on the installation drawing and refit it. 8. Confirm a minimum clearance of 8 mm between the solenoid body and the piccolo duct flange. 9. Connect the valve connector. 10. Restore pneumatic pressure and confirm no leakage at the valve body joint. 11. Command the valve open and closed three times and record the opening and closing times. WARNING: KEEP CLEAR OF THE VALVE ACTUATOR DURING THE FUNCTIONAL CHECK. THE BUTTERFLY MOVES WITHOUT WARNING WHEN THE SYSTEM IS PRESSURISED. 12. Confirm that both times are inside the acceptance band for the standard fitted. 13. Close the leading edge access panels.
sections.close_out: Remove the warning notice from the flight deck. Do the wing anti-ice functional test from the flight deck and confirm that no fault indication is produced. Record the measured opening and closing times, the solenoid part number and the standard fitted in the aircraft maintenance record.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Steps 7 and 8 apply only to aircraft post MOD-146540.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the pneumatic system is depressurised.
Keep clear of the valve actuator during the functional check.
Put the warning notice in position at the flight deck.

tooling.description: Clearance gauge, solenoid to duct flange
